none: PAS CAM-6B1156: Roman Coin : Nummus of Valens, AD 364-375
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Copper-alloy Nummus of Valens, AD 364-375 (Reece period 19). Reverese legend reads: SECVRITAS REIPVBLICAE. Reverse shows Victory advancing left with wreath and palm. Mint: in style of Arles AD 364-375. Obverse legend reads: DN VALENS PF AVG. Obverse shows Pearl diademed, draped and cuirassed bust facing right. Reverse fields and exergue read: OF-II//[..]. Die Axis: 12 o'clock. Diameter 17.6mm,…
